name: knowledge
description: Turns what a session taught into durable knowledge notes without shallow or misleading ones: triages the session for concepts, systems and mechanisms worth keeping, routes each to confirm (review only, the default), budgeted research in a read-only agent (only with a named reason) or record (what the user stated), checks every sourced claim in a clean-context reviewer, and drafts the note for approval with each fact marked stated, verified or corroborated; --deepen corroborates an existing note later. Store-agnostic (plain markdown by default, Basic Memory or any MCP-backed store by config) and source-agnostic (code, docs, tickets, web — whatever the project declares or has connected).
